title: Draft impact metrics and timeline with measurable open-source milestones
description: Define concrete success metrics: 1) Quantitative: 500 nodes deployed, X users at conference, packet delivery rate, latency stats. 2) Open-source: GitHub stars/forks, contributors, downstream projects. 3) Standards: IETF draft submissions, interop testing. 4) Community: deployment guides completed, training materials released. Create 12-month timeline with quarterly milestones. Include risk mitigation for hardware supply, spectrum regulations. ~300 words plus timeline graphic/table.
